item.description:
XHelpers Pro 1.0.14 (32)
- Use the new xhelperspro command helper to play or queue audio and video, open pictures and documents, and open Pro tools from scripts. - Audio tracks can show who requested playback, with a highlighted requester label that also works when Pro is already running. - The audio player opens at a size that fits its content without visibly widening afterward, with clearer playback controls and easier navigation between video and control windows. - AI Usage now shows available Codex credits with whole-number balances. - Updated player labels and command messages in all 25 supported languages.
